objs.name: document
objs.description: Main document artifact in DHC VISION; covers various document types and contains metadata and lifecycle information.

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation for the document type; used in the document name.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client, 4-digit number assigned per document type; included in the document name.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Document title used in the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version of the document; used in versioning and display.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope(s) of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: References attribute; part of the document properties.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications referenced by the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Relevant companies or areas of validity.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Areas of validity for the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Users or groups who are granted read access to the document.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Author(s) of the document; default is the creator; can be changed.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional authors who may contribute; not part of the release workflow.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Users who review the content for technical and formal aspects.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: User who releases the document to readers.

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Translator for language versions of released content.

attributes.name: distribution_list
attributes.description: Distribution lists; groups or individuals informed about release and/or acknowledged.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the current version is valid.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Defined period for validity extension (default 3 years).

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the version remains valid.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document by attaching a new information object with a document type.

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Edit the content or properties of a document.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Start the release workflow of a document; enables distribution and publication.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Publish a released document so readers can access it.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Extend the validity period of a released document.

evts.name: override
evts.description: Override/AKS: declare a document invalid or override its validity.

evts.name: reactivate
evts.description: Reactivate an archived or invalidated document.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive a document after override or invalidation.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content into another language and release translation.

evts.name: create_change_proposals
evts.description: Create change proposals for a document within the release workflow.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Document signatures are created and stored for released versions.

evts.name: distribute_document
evts.description: Distribute a document to distribution lists or user groups.

evts.name: attach_information
evts.description: Attach additional information or attachments to a document.

o2e.description: Document creation event triggers creation of a new Document object.
Document edit event triggers modification of the Document object.
Document release event triggers the release workflow for the Document.
Document publish event triggers visibility to readers.
Document validity extension event triggers updated Valid Until date.
Override event triggers an AKS/invalidity action on the Document.
Document reactivation event triggers new version creation.
Document archiving event triggers archive status.
Document translation event triggers translation workflow.
Event to create change proposals for the Document.
Event for collecting signatures on released Document version.
Event for distributing the Document to distribution lists.
